Appraiser remarks
Vehicle presented for estimate following a collision during a left-hand turn. Damage observed is concentrated on the front
driver-side corner, including a cracked bumper cover, a bent headlamp bracket, a damaged fender, and a broken grille clip. The
pattern of crush and displacement is consistent with the impact described by the insured. A few light scratches elsewhere on the
body appear weathered and may predate this loss; they are noted but are not included in the repair scope. Proposed plan is to
replace the bumper cover and fender, repair the bracket and hood alignment, and refinish the affected panels. Labor hours listed
on the estimate are in line with the damage found. The supporting invoices reviewed show no repeated charges for the same
work.
